$env:UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT='private-input/4b06809c9ca2d51ba83b'
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'
$env:OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1'
$env:OMP_NUM_THREADS='1'

$auditSource=@'
import csv, hashlib, json, math, re, time, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import Counter
from datetime import date, datetime
from itertools import accumulate
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'artifacts/rp4_v4_b4';report_path=root/'docs/rp4/results_v4.md'
def sha(p):
    with Path(p).open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def jread(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())
def cread(p):
    with Path(p).open(newline='',encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f))
def number(x,signed=False):return 'NO VERIFICABLE' if x is None else format(float(x),'+.8g' if signed else '.8g')
def path_from_pin(p):
    p=Path(p);return p if p.is_absolute() else root/p
t0=time.perf_counter();manifest=jread(out/'report_manifest.json')
assert sha(report_path)=='c42316748a57cfc1ce73681a98bacb1fb157ee3ec13983e222e3494d1996a2c7'
assert manifest['report_code_sha256']==sha(root/'artifacts/rp4_v4_code/report_v4_checked.py')=='17c0c0fc67336aa945db9c156bf6f0e1043206391e3d3f0bb5873382c0424c7c'
for group in ('input_sha256','output_sha256'):
    for p,d in manifest[group].items():assert sha(path_from_pin(p))==d,p
assert manifest['model_fits']==manifest['downloads']==0 and manifest['publication'] is False
assert manifest['rv15_primary_winning_families']==['log_ridge_harq']
report=report_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8');families=('log_ridge_harq','lightgbm_qlike');windows=('primary','confirmation');horizons=(30,15,5);contrasts=(('B1_over_B0','B0','B1'),('B2_over_B1','B1','B2'))
results={};receipts={};stats=cread(out/'primary_statistics.csv');assert len(stats)==24
for h in horizons:
    for window in windows:
        stage='b2' if window=='primary' else 'b3';folder=root/'artifacts'/(f'rp4_v3_{stage}' if h==30 else f'rp4_v4_{stage}_rv{h}')
        if h!=30:
            receipts[h,window]=jread(folder/'receipt.json');assert receipts[h,window]['status']=='COMPLETE' and receipts[h,window]['exit_code']==0
        summary=jread(folder/'summary.json');losses=cread(folder/'session_losses.csv');results[h,window]=(summary,losses)
        bilateral={(r['family'],r['contrast']):r for r in summary['comparability_bilateral']}
        for item in summary['contrasts']:
            matches=[r for r in stats if (int(r['horizon_minutes']),r['window'],r['family'],r['contrast'])==(h,window,item['family'],item['contrast'])];assert len(matches)==1
            actual=matches[0]
            for key,value in item.items():
                if value is None:assert actual[key]==''
                elif isinstance(value,(float,int)) and not isinstance(value,bool):assert float(actual[key])==value,(h,window,key)
                else:assert actual[key]==str(value),(h,window,key)
            pair=bilateral[item['family'],item['contrast']]
            assert float(actual['p_bilateral'])==pair['p_raw'] and float(actual['p_holm_bilateral'])==pair['p_holm']
for window,heading,endheading in [('primary','## Comparación primaria','## Comparación de confirmación'),('confirmation','## Comparación de confirmación','Delta positivo favorece')]:
    section=report.split(heading,1)[1].split(endheading,1)[0]
    actual_rows=[line for line in section.splitlines() if line.startswith(('| Ridge /','| LightGBM /'))];expected=[]
    for family in families:
        for contrast,_,_ in contrasts:
            cells=[('Ridge' if family==families[0] else 'LightGBM')+' / '+contrast]
            for h in horizons:
                item=next(r for r in results[h,window][0]['contrasts'] if (r['family'],r['contrast'])==(family,contrast))
                formal=number(item['p_for_decision']) if item['p_for_decision'] is not None else 'NO ABIERTA' if item['hypothesis_status']=='NOT_TESTED' else 'NO VERIFICABLE'
                cells += [f"{number(item['estimate'],True)} [{number(item['ci_low'])}, {number(item['ci_high'])}]",number(item['p_raw'])+' / '+formal,number(item['qlike_reduction_percent'],True),f"{item['N_sessions']}/{item['N_origins']}"]
            expected.append('| '+' | '.join(cells)+' |')
    assert actual_rows==expected,window
curves_checked=points_checked=0
for contrast,b0,b1 in contrasts:
    svg=ET.parse(out/(contrast+'.svg')).getroot();assert svg.attrib['viewBox']=='0 0 1680 1320'
    curves=svg.findall('.//{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}path');assert len(curves)==12;seen=set()
    for curve in curves:
        h=int(curve.attrib['data-horizon']);window=curve.attrib['data-window'];family=curve.attrib['data-family'];identity=(h,window,family);assert identity not in seen;seen.add(identity)
        rows=results[h,window][1];values=[0.0,*accumulate(float(r[f'loss__{family}__{b0}'])-float(r[f'loss__{family}__{b1}']) for r in rows)]
        assert float(curve.attrib['data-endpoint'])==values[-1] and int(curve.attrib['data-sessions'])==len(rows)
        col=horizons.index(h);wi=windows.index(window);fi=families.index(family);left,right=85+col*550,500+col*550;top,bottom=137+(wi*2+fi)*294,342+(wi*2+fi)*294
        low,high=min(values),max(values);pad=.08*(high-low) if high>low else 1.0;low-=pad;high+=pad
        days=[date.fromisoformat(r['session_date']).toordinal() for r in rows];times=[days[0]-1,*days]
        points=[(float(x),float(y)) for _,x,y in re.findall(r'([ML]) ([+-]?[0-9.]+) ([+-]?[0-9.]+)',curve.attrib['d'])]
        assert len(points)==len(rows)+1
        for (x,y),t,v in zip(points,times,values,strict=True):
            ex=left+(right-left)*(t-times[0])/(times[-1]-times[0]);ey=bottom-(v-low)*(bottom-top)/(high-low)
            assert x==float(f'{ex:.2f}') and y==float(f'{ey:.2f}') and left<=x<=right and top<=y<=bottom
        curves_checked+=1;points_checked+=len(points)
    assert seen=={(h,w,f) for h in horizons for w in windows for f in families}
coverage=cread(out/'coverage.csv');assert len(coverage)==36
for row in coverage:
    summary=results[int(row['horizon_minutes']),row['window']][0];source=next(r for r in summary['evaluation_quality_by_asset'] if r['asset']==row['asset'])
    for k,v in source.items():
        if v is None:assert row[k]==''
        elif isinstance(v,(int,float)):assert float(row[k])==v
        else:assert row[k]==str(v)
census=cread(out/'empty_census.csv');assert len(census)==48
for row in census:
    assert int(row['N_origins'])==sum(int(row[k]) for k in ('N_empty_origins','N_nonempty_origins','N_unknown_origins'))
fits=cread(out/'fit_selection_bounds.csv');assert len(fits)==(419+25)*2*6
bounds=cread(out/'bound_counts.csv');assert len(bounds)==24
for row in bounds:
    group=[r for r in fits if (r['horizon_minutes'],r['window'],r['information_set'],r['family'])==(row['horizon_minutes'],row['window'],row['information_set'],'log_ridge_harq')]
    names=('prediction_rows','count_low','count_high') if row['phase']=='evaluation' else ('validation_rows','validation_count_low','validation_count_high')
    totals=[sum(int(r[k]) for r in group) for k in names]
    assert [int(row[k]) for k in ('N_predictions','count_low','count_high')]==totals and totals[1]+totals[2]<=totals[0]
for name in ('distribution_secondary','posterior_mean','regime_secondary','high_gamma_vs_rest','top_loss_sessions','robustness'):
    data=cread(out/(name+'.csv'));assert len(data)==sum(len(results[h,w][0][name]) for h in (15,5) for w in windows)
timings=cread(out/'timing.csv');assert len(timings)==4
for row in timings:
    receipt=receipts[int(row['horizon_minutes']),row['window']]
    for k in ('started_at_utc','completed_at_utc'):assert row[k]==receipt[k]
    assert float(row['elapsed_seconds'])==receipt['elapsed_seconds']
    for k,v in receipt['resources'].items():
        if isinstance(v,(int,float)):assert float(row[k])==v
        else:assert row[k]==v
missing_links=[]
for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',report):
    if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
    p=(report_path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve()
    if not p.exists():missing_links.append(link)
assert not missing_links,missing_links
required_phrases=['Se reporta el alcance por familia; RV5 no decide el resultado.','no implica control global 5% entre familias ni versiones.','H2 NO ABIERTA significa que H1 no rechazó','IC95% percentil bilateral; p unilateral de nula centrada.','Esta es la cuarta evaluación de las mismas ventanas','no una quinta versión ni réplica independiente','Los p dentro de una versión no corrigen toda la búsqueda anterior.','La ventana 20 de julio a 28 de agosto fue leída una vez','El PIT es proxy de tiempo fuente a 120 s','Hueco UW aceptado: 2025-01-25 a 2025-02-24','Un resultado no rechazado no demuestra ausencia o absorción','RESEARCH_ONLY','capital_go=false']
assert all(p in report for p in required_phrases)
assert results[5,'confirmation'][0]['predeclared_closure']['satisfied'] is None
elapsed_total=math.fsum(float(r['elapsed_seconds']) for r in timings)
elapsed_span=(datetime.fromisoformat(timings[-1]['completed_at_utc'])-datetime.fromisoformat(timings[0]['started_at_utc'])).total_seconds()
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS_INDEPENDENT_FINAL_B4_REPORT','report_SHA256':sha(report_path),'report_manifest_SHA256':sha(out/'report_manifest.json'),'report_code_SHA256':sha(root/'artifacts/rp4_v4_code/report_v4_checked.py'),'test_report_checked_SHA256':sha(root/'artifacts/rp4_v4_code/test_report_checked.py'),'input_hashes_verified':len(manifest['input_sha256']),'output_hashes_verified':len(manifest['output_sha256']),'primary_statistics_rows_exact':len(stats),'main_table_contrast_horizon_cells_exact':24,'cumulative_curves_checked':curves_checked,'cumulative_points_checked':points_checked,'coverage_rows':len(coverage),'empty_census_rows':len(census),'fit_selection_rows':len(fits),'bound_count_rows':len(bounds),'all_links_exist':not missing_links,'adverse_signs_and_closed_H2_preserved':True,'family_specific_primary_RV15_success_not_global_claim':True,'elapsed_execution_sum_seconds':elapsed_total,'elapsed_execution_wall_span_seconds':elapsed_span,'audit_elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-t0,'new_fits':0,'bootstrap_reruns':0,'files_written':0,'threads_max':1,'scope_note':'Checks copied inferential fields against immutable sources and arithmetic/plots only; no statistical resampling or model evaluation rerun.'}),flush=True)
'@
$auditSource | uv run --offline --frozen --no-sync python -B -
exit $LASTEXITCODE
